researchNotes: Larry's words relayed third-person by his son, who typed on his own @mdfmkl account during the 2026-08-15 session (Larry dictating at the table). Cataloged on VN-0005. The unnamed man at left — someone Larry 'knew really well' — is the guitarist of the guitar-session series per the follow-up comment; one name would resolve several photos.
